title: Rocket plane travel to work
content: An airport in the same place as mallworld, I was late for a plane that would take me to another continent for work and when I made it I was so nervous and scared I almost woke myself up but I couldn't because I knew i needed to make it to this job or I wouldn't be allowed to come back and when the plane took off it was like my face was being pulled back a little then we were floating in our seats then back to being pushed back in our seats and when we landed it was so rough and crazy (the flight was like 5 mins altogether but it was my first time). When I got out I seen we were in a plane like rocket and I was jw if anyone experienced anything like this? The airport also had flight times for places like the moon/lunar airport, mars airport and other places. Sorry about the shty drawing
